entities.name: Kjeldoran Hinterlands
entities.description: Large rural stretch of Kjeldor bordering the Kher Ridges and Karplusan Mountains, home to most of Kjeldor's tough peasant population.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: Nation whose rural population dwelt in the Hinterlands.

entities.name: Glimmer Vale
entities.description: Gulch of churned-up mica at the foot of Raynor Glacier in the Hinterlands.

entities.name: Breway
entities.description: Hinterlands village that fell to Lim-Dûl's armies.

entities.name: Freyta
entities.description: Hinterlands village that fell to Lim-Dûl's armies.

entities.name: Jarka
entities.description: Hinterlands village that fell to Lim-Dûl's armies.

entities.name: Mikkel
entities.description: Hinterlands village that fell to Lim-Dûl's armies.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: Necromancer whose armies destroyed Hinterlands villages.

entities.name: Krov
entities.description: One of Kjeldor's three great cities, capital.

entities.name: Varchild
entities.description: Born in the Hinterlands, later General of the Kjeldoran armies.

entities.name: Zur the Enchanter
entities.description: Hosted in the Hinterlands after his revolt and splinter from the Royal Academy of Magic.

entities.name: Thaw
entities.description: End of the Ice Age after which Kjeldor and Balduvia united.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: Nation the Hinterlands became part of after the Thaw.

events.summary: The Hinterlands' villages Breway, Freyta, Jarka and Mikkel fall to Lim-Dûl's armies with few survivors.
events.quote: All of these villages fell to the armies of Lim-Dûl, with few survivors.

events.summary: Zur the Enchanter is hosted in the Hinterlands after his revolt and faction splintered from the Royal Academy of Magic.
events.quote: the Hinterlands that hosted Zur the Enchanter after his revolt and faction splinter off from the Royal Academy of Magic

events.summary: After the Thaw and the union of Kjeldor and Balduvia, the hinterlands become part of New Argive.
events.quote: the hinterlands became part of New Argive
